sentences.text: Swayambar Kumar Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:3939
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 36346 of 2024
Applicant :- Swayambar Kumar Gautam

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Gupta,Raghawendra Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 136 of 2023, under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Khejuri,
District- Ballia with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place about three and a half months prior to the incident.
The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the applicant are false.

Learned counsel has referred statement of P.W.-1 Ram Lal, who has not supported the prosecution version in his Swayambar Kumar Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49983552/
1 cross-examination.

entities.text: Swayambar Kumar Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Similarly, P.W.-2 Sunita Devi and P.W.-3 Anshu Bharti have not supported the prosecution version and turned hostile and they have denied the prosecution version regarding the dowry demand and harassment of deceased.
Lastly, it was stated that the applicant is in jail since 21.09.2023 and that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death due to hanging within period of about three months of her marriage at her parental home.
In his examination in chief, P.W.-1 has supported the prosecution version but during cross-examination he has back-track from his version.
The suicide note of deceased was referred and it was sbmitted that from suicide note of deceased, it appears that deceased was being harassed by applicant and his family members.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, suicide note of deceased and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, no case for grant of bail is made out at this stage.
6. Accordingly, the bail application filed on behalf of applicant Swayambar Kumar Gautam is rejected.

7. However, considering facts of the matter and period of detention of applicant, the Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same, as early as possible, if there is no other legal impediment.
8. A copy of this order be transmitted to the Trial Court concerned for necessary compliance.
Order Date :- 8.1.2025
